items.interimBehavior: Optional Male/Female field on a worker (project lead instruction, 28 Oct 2026). Shown in Masters and as a women/men count on the attendance register; not used for tasks, pay or rates and not exported to public trace. Estate-owner answer still open.

items.question: Temperature and rain are recorded twice a day for both estates by the same supervisor, from one place in each estate. Are other readings needed, or other places?
items.interimBehavior: Daily log kinds are configuration. Temperature (°C) and Rain (mm) twice a day are seeded only in development and staging fixtures; production kinds are created by the tenant admin after confirmation.

items.question: A supervisor's phone may be without internet for up to 7 days before it needs a full sign-in again.

items.question: Attendance, Daily log and weigh-in entries made without internet may appear in the office reports only after the phone syncs. Until then the phone shows each entry as waiting.
items.interimBehavior: Reports count only server-accepted records and show separately how many entries devices reported as waiting.

items.question: If two supervisors mark the same worker on the same day, the manager decides which entry is kept.
